en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photo of a rural, hilly landscape with houses, fields, and trees. There are forested hills in the background. The caption at the bottom of the image reads 'BAD PYRMONT. Blick auf Friedental.' The reverse side contains handwritten notes in German, a German postage stamp with the inscription 'DEUTSCHES REICH' and a museum stamp reading 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS'. The postcard is formatted with spaces for an address and a message, typical of early 20th-century German postcards.
